reviews.title: Wow, it's genuinely amazing.
reviews.comment:
Thinner than others and has a kinda quiet fan that can ramp up when it needs to. For gaming it's absolutely amazing.
Only downside is that it got a bit hotter than I fel comfortable with. So I replaced some of the thermal pads and paste. Now it's cooler and quieter.
Still, I was impressed with the default pads other than the memory ones. It's quite thoroughly cooled.
reviews.author: Jonathan
